items.name: InputDevice::DeadZoneChop
items.plate_base: InputDevice::DeadZoneChop(float &, float, float) (static). Zeroes the value when it lies strictly between the two bounds; XBoxPadDevice::PollDevice applies it to the four stick axes with -0.4 and 0.4.

items.name: XBoxPadDevice::scalar_deleting_destructor
items.plate_base: XBoxPadDevice's scalar deleting destructor (vtable slot 0): runs the destructor (0x51d80) and, with flags bit 0, frees the 0x56c bytes through UMemory::FastFree. Was labelled ~XBoxPadDevice.

items.name: PAD_update
items.plate_base: PAD_update (EA's input library, librealinputz; not an IOModule member). Polls XAPI for insertions and removals, opens and closes pads, and reads each open pad into its 0x90-byte record at 0x241c50 (+0x90 per port): stick floats with a 0.25 deadzone, buttons and newly pressed buttons, analogue bytes and their press edges. Registered as a SYNCTASK by PAD_init and also called by IOModule::Update.

items.name: PAD_init
items.plate_base: PAD_init (EA's input library, librealinputz; not an IOModule member). Once: clears the four pad records, opens every gamepad XGetDevices reports (handle and capabilities into its record), and adds PAD_update as a SYNCTASK.
